what_this_is: The filter grammar behind the `query=` parameter every collection read accepts. Established from the application's own request, then mapped by probing operators against a known row.

grammar.column_names: the camelCase JSON field names the resource returns — NOT the DB column names its 422 errors quote
grammar.empty: query=[] means no filter; 295 of 298 recorded calls before this used exactly that.

operators.pattern_matching: There is no LIKE. A `%` wildcard inside an EQ value works: carrierCode EQ "00%" returned 3 rows where EQ "0000" returned 1.
operators.case: Operators are case-sensitive and upper-case. "eq" is a 422.

caution: A wrong-but-parseable clause returns 200 with ZERO rows rather than an error. That is indistinguishable from "no matches", so a filtered read that returns nothing must be re-checked against an unfiltered count before concluding the record does not exist.

related.filter_param: The grids also carry an Ext-style `filter` param, but RPUX.rest.RestProxy.getParams() deletes it whenever remoteFiltering is false — which is the case on every Configuration grid, so those filter client-side over an already-loaded page.
related.filter_columns_endpoint: /rpux/filter/columns/<Entity> lists the columns a grid offers in its filter UI. Most entities return an empty list; it is not a reliable source for what `query` accepts.
